messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great progress! Your phone now has excellent 5G signal, which is perfect for MMS.

Since you're traveling abroad in France, you'll need both mobile data and data roaming turned ON for MMS to work properly. Don't worry—turning these settings on won't delete any of your photos, contacts, or other data on your phone.

Let's start by turning ON mobile data. Please use:

**toggle_data**

This will enable your phone to use the cellular network for internet access. After you've done that, let me know, and we'll proceed to turn on data roaming next.

I have turned on mobile data on my phone. The status bar shows an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled. What do I need to do next? Should I turn on data roaming now? Will that cause any extra charges or problems? I'm a bit concerned.

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
